subject: biology-1
question: During cell division, fibers pull the duplicated chromosomes to opposite ends of the cell. Which component of the **cytoskeleton** forms these pulling fibers?
explanation: Microtubules assemble into the mitotic spindle, whose fibers attach to the chromosomes and pull them apart during division. B fails because microfilaments power contraction and cell movement, not chromosome separation. C fails because intermediate filaments provide mechanical support. D fails because ribosomes are not part of the cytoskeleton.
